## 📝 Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## 🔀 Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚙️ Tooling / CI / Build system change

## 🧪 Testing Checklist

- [ ] Tested on **iOS Native** (Simulator or Real Device)
- [ ] Tested on **Android Native** (Emulator or Real Device)
- [ ] Tested with **New Architecture (TurboModules)** enabled
- [ ] Tested with **Old Architecture (Bridge)**
- [ ] Verified `yarn build` passes without errors
- [ ] Verified `yarn typecheck` and `yarn lint` pass without errors
